Fixed assumes the proposed checked spin-prefix contract: failure returns no ownership; success transfers initialized mutex-backed resources into the later VM rollback. Legacy controls use the selected ticket backend. Assumes root-table failure rollback, free_msections lifetime, successful destruction, initially valid global list and externally quiescent constructor. P0 is not yet memory-ready. List characterization only covers source guards during successful construction; unpublication/readers, C weak memory, real allocator/OS behavior, activity-log cleanup and native acceptance remain open. Durable source032 context replaces cache references; this remains a proposed VM-memory ownership protocol, not an implemented callee repair.
